title: Taking Refuge
speaker: Nomon Tim Burnett
summary: The main teaching of the Soto Zen dharma talk emphasizes the importance of embracing a universal reality beyond our individual egos and desires. By taking refuge in Buddha and the Dharma, we can experience transformation and growth, and discover that our true nature is not separate from that of the Buddha. This involves letting go of control and manipulation, and instead embracing our authentic selves, much like the natural world does.
